stage: Direct-port real-state storage integration diagnostic, not the game

hardware.cpu: 486DX/25, accurate interpreter; no dynarec or interpreter override
hardware.hdd: Private 20 MiB FAT16 ESDI diagnostic; generic 1989_3500rpm proxy, not final Wren V

native_suite.world_storage: Two native x86 processes, real Win32 file I/O and DOS arenas/adapters; DOS paths and commit substituted only
native_suite.mob_codec: Eight tests; unchanged staged mobs.c and real math/RNG, diagnostic heap/callback fixtures

guest.emulator: 86Box 6.0 b9001, pinned ordinary binary and ROMs

both_reports.counter_scope: Since terrain_reset during load. The write phase separately asserts positive RAM-cache hits before that reset.

guest.cleanup: After both reports were written/closed and save bytes verified, executable and exact private VM command line were checked before stopping completed idle PID 33612. Images/reports preserved.

verification: Byte-identical staged world.c, mobs.c, inventory.c and all three column includes; vendor verification passed all 50 pinned files.
Deterministic flat world imported through the original API; distinct per-column markers detect owner/coordinate errors. Actual cache/lighting/meshing paths exercised, but no render output.

Dirty plank/torch column actually evicts and adds HDD writes, then returns with exact blocks and adjacent block-light level 13. Original active/dormant owners migrate before traversal using unchanged policy.
Width256 follows original v3 selection; materialization, full terrain RLE, actual mob fields/IDs/visited state, player/inventory/chest state and post-load travel checked.
Independent Python oracle checks every save byte, checksum, RLE, state and untouched trailing tracks. Reload does not alter the durable save file.
Native repeated write refuses nonblank save before touching either file. Launcher tests reject missing/malformed fixtures, nonblank save, wrong hashes and modified two-process startup.
limitations: Not playable or accepted full parity. Audio, physics/combat, renderer and input callbacks are unused diagnostic stubs; procedural generation is not measured or exercised by the flat imported fixture.
Actual v4 mixed saved-column/scratch ownership and failures remain separate integration gates; mock transport/fault tests are not a substitute.
Fresh DOS process, not full machine reboot, power-loss recovery or physical-drive durability.
Whole save has an independent byte oracle; final terrain payload hash is recorded, not independently reconstructed as a whole-file oracle.
Elapsed ticks cover large diagnostics, not FPS or generation performance. One screenshot showed emulation at 70%; host speed was not continuously measured.
No optimization, new spawning/freeze rule, save policy, heap/world budget, UI, emulator, ROM or user-medium change. Runtime media remain ignored.
